column1: # The ledger of what the plain reactions wait for (IMPLEMENTATION.md 8.3; Phase 3 tasks 3.2 to 3.4). One line for each engine piece a "// NEEDS" in Runtime/Player/Trees/Reactions/ names, with the reactions it would finish; each reaction already does the rest at its simplest faithful version. Delete a line when its piece is built and its reactions are finished. Ordered by how many reactions a piece would finish.

column2: what is missing

Ground that keeps acting on whatever stands in it, by condition or test: a pool or net that slows whoever wades in later, a slick that floats whoever comes to four doses in it, pools of damp left where they settle (now the condition goes with the enemies it reached, or only the reacting enemy is tested)
column3: The Ground Gives, Caught Light, Chokedamp, Fish Poison

column2: The reaction's own look beyond the placeholder puff (task 3.5 and the approved effects): the hidden flame, the roots on the floor, the jar's black ring, the scorched fern, the mock suns turning with the enemy
column3: Smoulder, Rot Roots, Shut in the Dark, Earthed, Mock Suns

column2: A cooldown kept per enemy rather than one clock per effect for all enemies (an elite's flinch once every 4 s, a bite once every half second, a heal of 8 a second)

Standing things that block movement and shots and can be struck: the iron-faced anvil stone (also "stone at its back" for Hammer and Anvil), the rimed mound of 1.5 m, the hollow trunk left where a girdled enemy dies
The side of the enemy a blow comes from (the face it showed the player, or its flanks)
An enemy freezing as a moment the reactions can answer ("at once if it freezes", "when it freezes")
Pickups: things on the floor the player picks up by walking over them (heal, a critical next blow, a charged blow); then they do not flower
A shove or throw of one enemy as a moment (a Gust, a ram, Riptide, a lift); a heavy blow stands in
A count set from an affliction's depth: thorns, one for each notch carried; a whirl's stagger scaled by its shards
A burst or ground that spares the enemy it starts from (the grounded enemy is struck by its own fern; the seized one is charged by its own film)
An enemy state that forbids dodging, leaping and stepping back, and draws the body lower when sunk
Discharges and arcs within 6 m that bend toward one enemy (the live flame) and burst again there, once every 0.8 s
A thrown body that meets something on the way: what it hits takes the discharge first
Deaths inside a ring as a moment: poisoned enemies dying inside give the jar every dose (to twelve, past the usual eight) and each kill inside feeds the player 4
Links that pass a share of weapon damage both ways, and a leash that keeps two enemies within 4 m (or one within 2 m of a spot); gods are never leashed
Poison held back on one enemy: it stops biting for a time, then every bite held back lands at once, doubled
A burst shaped as a star of cracks: only enemies standing on the seams are struck, not a disc
A hold that reaches gods at 0.4 of its time (now what cannot be frozen is not held)
Sundered past its usual three, up to five, so the plate falls at five
An affliction that stays for the rest of the fight (two minutes of keeping stand in)
The enemy's own blow landing on the player or the guard as a moment; and a condition that drifts to the nearest enemy within 6 m when its carrier dies
Burns that bite harder on one enemy (twice as hard while it glows)
A finisher as the blow a condition answers, apart from any heavy blow
Things thrown from an enemy in a fan, each stopping at the first it touches, riding the way the enemy was last shoved
The player's grown things as sources: each grown thing within 8 m throws a bolt into the enemy (four at most)
Ground laid along the path a thrown enemy travels, with the doses shed shared among the enemies it settles on
